sources.title: GitHub - dokterkepin/nxp_omniman_ws: Omnidirectional Mecanum Mobile ...
sources.snippet: A ROS 2 Humble mobile manipulator featuring a mecanum-wheeled base with a 6-DOF arm and gripper. The robot uses CyberGear motors (base + arm), Dynamixel servos (wrist + gripper), and an RPLidar for SLAM and navigation.
